Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Themed Widgets and Review Improvements
- Added themed DPS Meter layouts and optional animated backgrounds with adjustable effect visibility and density.
- Made the meter header more compact and color-coded player rows by role.
- Improved name redaction for all captured players and added separate DPS Meter opacity and icon-size controls.
- Added per-death diagnostic codes and strengthened player identity checks to reduce false deaths.
- Improved Black Hole tether analysis when a blast does not hit a player.
